annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council Laying Down Harmonised Rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and Amending Certain Union Legislative Acts
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council Laying Down Harmonised Rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and Amending Certain Union Legislative Acts
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: The European Commission's April 2021 proposal for the EU Artificial Intelligence Act. It sets a horizontal, risk-based framework with prohibited practices, mandatory requirements and conformity assessment for high-risk AI, transparency duties, sandboxes and an AI Board. It is integrated with product safety law, including machinery, medical devices and vehicles.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibits manipulative AI, public-authority social scoring and most real-time remote biometric identification for law enforcement
High-risk AI, including safety components of machinery and medical devices, must meet requirements on risk management, data, documentation, human oversight, robustness and cybersecurity
Conformity assessment and CE marking, integrated into existing NLF product legislation for AI in products
Establishes a European AI Board, national supervisory authorities, an EU database and post-market incident reporting
Fines up to EUR 30 million or 6% of turnover; regulatory sandboxes and codes of conduct for non-high-risk AI
